name: rex-extensions
description: Claude Code plugins for the Rex terminal

plugins.name: rex-view
plugins.description: Show images, Markdown, documents and source code in a floating pane over the Rex tab Claude runs in, through leaf when it is installed

plugins.name: rex-sidecar-task-list
plugins.description: Set up the rex-sidecar Google Tasks or Reminders tab step by step, and keep its task lists in step with the work done in a Claude Code session
